# Library benchmark: tables generated by scripts/library_benchmark.py (do not edit)

Median of 3 timed runs (min–max in brackets), M cells/s; steps: median (range) of steps 2 to 10. "breaks": what the row does not share with the headline rules (periodic box, double, exact predicates, device-resident timing, centroids). Same hardware: every A100 job ran voronoi-cpp's warp rebuild as a reference on its GPU (section "Same GPU"). Volumes-only codes: the README's setting per input, then every setting.
